description_en: Queries the information about the source code repository that is bound to an image repository
description_zh: 获取源代码仓库的绑定信息
kebab_example: aliyun cr get-repo-source-code-repo --instance-id cri-shac42yvqzvq0000 --repo-id crr-gzsrlevmvoaq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRepoSourceCodeRepo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Container Registry instance
parameters.name: instance_id

AutoBuild.description_en:
Indicates whether image building is automatically triggered when source code is committed. Valid values:

`true`: Image building is automatically triggered when source code is committed.
`false`: Image building is not triggered when source code is committed
AutoBuild.description_zh:
是否打开源代码提交自动触发构建，取值：

`true`：打开源代码提交自动触发构建

`false`：关闭源代码提交自动触发构建

CodeRepoDomain.description_en: The address of the source code repository

CodeRepoName.description_en: The name of the source code repository

CodeRepoNamespaceName.description_en: The namespace to which the source code repository belongs
CodeRepoNamespaceName.description_zh: 源代码仓库命名空间名称

CodeRepoType.description_en: The type of the code hosting platform. Valid values: `GITHUB`, `GITLAB`, `GITEE`, `CODE`, and `CODEUP`

DisableCacheBuild.description_en:
Indicates whether build cache is disabled. Valid values:

`true`: Build cache is disabled.
`false`: Build cache is enabled
DisableCacheBuild.description_zh:
是否关闭构建缓存，取值：

`true`：关闭构建缓存

`false`：打开构建缓存

IsSuccess.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call is successful. Valid values:

`true`: successful
`false`: failed
IsSuccess.description_zh:
是否调用API成功，取值：

`true`：调用API成功

`false`：调用API失败

OverseaBuild.description_en:
Indicates whether image building is accelerated for servers outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

`true`: Image building is accelerated for servers outside the Chinese mainland.
`false`: Image building is not accelerated for servers outside the Chinese mainland
OverseaBuild.description_zh:
是否打开海外源智能构建加速，取值：

`true`：打开海外源智能构建加速

`false`：关闭海外源智能构建加速
